---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest a new module, analysis, or workflow
labels: enhancement
---

## What you'd want to do
The research task or workflow you have in mind that the current tools
don't support.

## How you imagine it working
UI sketch, mockup, or just prose describing the interaction.

## Existing alternatives
Is there a related feature already in the workbench (or in Younger's
database, mwenge/lineara.xyz, AntConc, etc.) that comes close? How does
your idea differ?

## Why this matters
What kind of question or analysis this would unlock that currently can't
be done in the workbench.
